references.text: Jesus warns the disciples about persecution and that they will be betrayed even by close family members, which mirrors the warning in Matthew 24:10 that many will fall away from the faith and betray one another.
Micah prophesies about a time when trust between people will erode, and family and friends will betray each other, similar to the prediction in Matthew 24:10.
Jeremiah expresses distrust toward everyone around him and warns against trusting brothers and friends, reflecting the theme of betrayal among close relationships in Matthew 24:10.
Jesus warns that the disciples will be betrayed even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends, which reflects the warning in Matthew 24:10 about betrayal and hatred.
